title: Proposal: working together on SCN8A-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into SCN8A-related disorders.
We are writing to The Cute Syndrome Foundation because you support families affected by SCN8A-related disorders.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work links SCN8A changes to both gain of function and loss of function, depending on the variant.
People with SCN8A changes are included in the International SCN8A Registry and Citizen Health, and a registry and natural history study of epilepsy-dyskinesia syndromes is recruiting.
Two NBI-921352 studies were terminated by sponsor decision.
A phase 2/3 PRAX-562 trial is active but not recruiting and excludes loss-of-function variants.
An antisense approach is still preclinical, and evidence on sodium channel blocking medicines differs between gain- and loss-of-function forms.
We would propose a study on [research question about SCN8A-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how the International SCN8A Registry or your community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
